import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from your_module import ChemistLabScreen, SymptomScreen, PatientProfileScreen

class TestChemistLabScreen(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_query_chemist_lab(self):
        chemist_lab_screen = ChemistLabScreen()
        chemist_lab_screen.query_chemist_lab("chemist_id")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.chemist_name, "Chemist Name")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.chemist_address, "Chemist Address")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.chemist_contact_details, "Chemist Contact Details")

    def test_query_non_existent_chemist_lab(self):
        chemist_lab_screen = ChemistLabScreen()
        with patch('your_module.get_chemist_lab', return_value=None):
            chemist_lab_screen.query_chemist_lab("non_existent_id")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.error_message, "Chemist or Lab does not exist")

    def test_delete_chemist_lab_with_open_prescriptions(self):
        chemist_lab_screen = ChemistLabScreen()
        with patch('your_module.get_open_prescriptions', return_value=[1, 2, 3]):
            chemist_lab_screen.delete_chemist_lab("chemist_id")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.error_message, "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete")

    def test_delete_chemist_lab_without_open_prescriptions(self):
        chemist_lab_screen = ChemistLabScreen()
        with patch('your_module.get_open_prescriptions', return_value=[]):
            chemist_lab_screen.delete_chemist_lab("chemist_id")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_lab_screen.chemist_name, "")

class TestSymptomScreen(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_symptom_code(self):
        symptom_screen = SymptomScreen()
        symptom_screen.add_symptom_code("symptom_code", "symptom_description")
        self.assertEqual(symptom_screen.symptom_code, "symptom_code")
        self.assertEqual(symptom_screen.symptom_description, "symptom_description")

    def test_edit_symptom_code(self):
        symptom_screen = SymptomScreen()
        symptom_screen.edit_symptom_code("symptom_code", "new_symptom_description")
        self.assertEqual(symptom_screen.symptom_code, "symptom_code")
        self.assertEqual(symptom_screen.symptom_description, "new_symptom_description")

    def test_delete_symptom_code(self):
        symptom_screen = SymptomScreen()
        symptom_screen.delete_symptom_code("symptom_code")
        self.assertEqual(symptom_screen.symptom_code, "")

class TestPatientProfileScreen(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_update_patient_profile(self):
        patient_profile_screen = PatientProfileScreen()
        patient_profile_screen.update_patient_profile("patient_id", "name", "age", "sex", "address", "contact_details")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_id, "patient_id")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_name, "name")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_age, "age")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_sex, "sex")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_address, "address")
        self.assertEqual(patient_profile_screen.patient_contact_details, "contact_details")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
